**Tier 3** — derived — a pure function of tier 2 · owned by `platform` · `public.kg_identity_review`

**One row is** One name in an organization's evidence that matched more than one entity, waiting for a person to decide — the resolver never picks (docs/PLAN.md §29 rule 3).

## Uniqueness

| Columns | Source | Constraint |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | column PRIMARY KEY | `kg_identity_review_pkey` |
| `organization_id` + `normalized` + `country` | UNIQUE index | `kg_identity_review_natural_key` |

**Natural key:** `organization_id` + `normalized` + `country` — the key this table's grain implies, and the
database ENFORCES it: `kg_identity_review_natural_key`. A re-upload of the same row updates
it rather than duplicating it.

## Constraints

These reject the row outright. A value that fails one of them does not arrive
partially or get corrected — the write fails.

| Constraint | Rule | Added by |
|---|---|---|
| `kg_identity_review_mention_check` | `CHECK (char_length(mention) BETWEEN 1 AND 300)` | `20261107000001_kg_entities.sql` |
| `kg_identity_review_candidates_check` | `CHECK (jsonb_typeof(candidates) = 'array')` | `20261107000001_kg_entities.sql` |
| `kg_identity_review_status_check` | `CHECK (status IN ('pending','resolved','dismissed'))` | `20261107000001_kg_entities.sql` |

## Governance

| | |
|---|---|
| Read capability | any project member |
| Write capability | **no user-facing write path** |
| Minimum project role | `viewer` |
| Tier transitions audited | yes |
| Row-level security | enabled |
| Policies on the table | **none** |

Per organization, and unlike external_evidence (readable by everyone) no API role may SELECT it: RLS is on with no policy and no grant. Reads go through kg_list_entities, writes through kg_upsert_entity and kg_queue_identity_review, each SECURITY DEFINER and each refusing an actor outside the organization (insufficient_privilege) or no actor at all — the organization check is kg_assert_org_member, and a super admin may read any graph. Audited at tier 3 by the three statement-grain triggers (rehearsal/960 proves the row names the actor). Outside the simulation: no engine input and no graph-hash scope reads it (PLAN.md §29 rule 4).

> **RLS is on and this table has no policy.** That is deny-all for every role except
> `service_role`, which bypasses RLS. If a page reads this table directly and gets zero
> rows, this is why.
